summary: Baileys fork silently relays checkBan() phone numbers to an unrelated third-party host
details: This fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library adds a checkBan(number) helper that issues fetch('https://kyuux-r.indevs.in/api/check-whatsapp?phone=${normalizedNumber}') against a hardcoded third-party endpoint. The destination is not WhatsApp, not the declared publisher domain, and is not caller-configurable. Every phone number passed by the consuming application - which for a WhatsApp bot typically includes contact identifiers of the operator and of arbitrary users interacting with the bot - is disclosed to the operator of kyuux-r.indevs.in. The advertised behavior of the helper (a ban check) does not require sending the identifier to that third party, and the relay is undocumented, giving the endpoint operator an unadvertised feed of phone numbers processed by any application that uses this method.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
